notes: STRONG HNI CANDIDATE - Director of Cath Lab at AIG Hospitals. Identity verified on four criteria (name + specialty Cardiology + hospital AIG + city Hyderabad) across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources that agree: (1) aighospitals.com own doctor profile https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-anuj-kapadiya (live page, title 'Doctor Profile | AIG Hospitals' - not a 404), which states 'Director of Cathlab and Senior Consultant Cardiologist'; and (2) the Government of India Advantage Healthcare directory https://healinindia.gov.in/doctors/dr-anuj-kapadiya, a .gov.in domain, titled 'Dr. Anuj Kapadiya - Cardiology in AIG Hospitals'. Hence High. Full name appears in directories as 'Dr. Anuj Amrit Kapadiya'; Practo's slug uses the variant spelling 'kapadia' but the listing itself reads 'Dr. Anuj Amrit Kapadiya - Cardiologist in Gachibowli, Hyderabad' at AIG Hospital, so it is the same person. NO EMAIL OR PHONE RECORDED: no direct email or phone for him was published on any official page. HexaHealth surfaced a number (8929723773) and an email (hello@hexahealth.com) - both DISCARDED as aggregator helpline/contact, per the standing rule that aggregator helplines reach the aggregator and not the doctor. JustDial listing also seen and DISCARDED as a call-tracking proxy. Nothing was constructed. Experience figures conflict between sources (28 years in directory listings vs 'career spanning 18 years' in press) - flagged for human check; the source row carried no experience figure. LinkedIn URL appeared verbatim in search results and is his own personal profile, not a company page.
